scripts.wasm:dev: cargo build -p game --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/src/wasm --out-name game target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/game.wasm
scripts.wasm:release: cargo build -p game --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/src/wasm --out-name game target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/game.wasm
scripts.build: npm run wasm:release && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
